keyEvents.text: Goal! Rayo Vallecano 0, Valencia 1. Copete (Valencia) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Javi Guerra with a cross following a corner.
Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Rayo Vallecano 0, Valencia 1.
Second Half begins Rayo Vallecano 0, Valencia 1.
